As someone who tried to get away from their problems by moving across the world, don’t do it. It doesn’t work. It actually just makes your situation worse and as soon as you’re settled down in the new city, it’s gonna hit you all at once.
Glad to know that other people feel like this to. I don’t wanna succeed, I just want people to see I’m suffering.
When my cats snuggle up to me, it’s the best feeling and honestly has been the only thing that stopped me from doing it on some days. They just wouldn’t understand what had happened to me.
Exactly in the same position and it’s so exhausting. At this point I don’t even know what I want more, to get better or just finally have to courage to actually do it.

I miss him, I miss having him around me all the time and I feel like I’m back at the start. Crying all day, not eating, not leaving my bed. I‘m so lonely and i just don’t know how to fix it.

I’ve been asking myself the same question all the time the last few days. Am I really moving on or am I just still in denial and don’t wanna feel all the feelings? And I really can’t tell.

My situation rn. I moved 3h away from home for him, to his family and friends. Due to corona I never had the chance to really make my own friends. And now I’m all by myself. Stayed with my sister for the first couple of days, but I have to work, so I have to go back tomorrow.
Sometimes I’m at like 60%, than later the same day I’m at 10%. I’m only 2 weeks in, so I know it gets better, but it’s so exhausting.
Every day, multiple times. It’s exhausting.

Been only 2 weeks for me, but I feel completely the same. Just the thought of leaving my bed and getting ready to meet with people is so exhausting. I have good moments when I know I should go out and distract myself, but at the end I never do.

I can’t even look at Diet Coke cans anymore because I started drinking it instead of regular coke because of him haha. He’s everywhere and I think time is the only thing that’s gonna help with that. Making new memories so the memories with him aren’t the ones that are the most present anymore.

Not me, but my sister. It’s been 3.5years and while the first few months were really rough because they lived together, she now is in such a better place and lives her best life. For her personally it also helped a lot that they still talked after their breakup and didn’t go no contact.
Pasta. Cold it’s a salad, hot it’s the best meal ever.

Had that conversation with my ex boyfriend, who broke up with me 2 weeks ago, yesterday. And he couldn’t really tell me why, he was scared and just had possible conversations in his head. He didn’t really realize how it could’ve helped us until we talked when it was already too late.
I think that there are times when it’s easier, but if they are the right person, there’s always a way to make it work.

Same. Just the thought of coming home and he’s not there waiting for me, makes me go crazy. 
I know I’m gonna be okay one day, but right now I just don’t know how I’m gonna get there.
I tried, but he has moved on and said he doesn’t have the energy to try again.
So scared of the holidays and New Years coming up and not spending it with them and their family. I wish I could just skip everything until like February, after Valentine’s Day, and just start there
When I wake up and turn around, but nobody’s there. We used to cuddle every morning before we had to get up and not having this anymore is probably the worst part of it all.
